WITH transaction_sentiment AS (
  SELECT
    tr.transreg,
    tr.ordertypedist,
    AVG(sf.shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest_days_to_cover,
    AVG(sf.optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio
  FROM transactionrecord AS tr
  INNER JOIN sentimentandfundamentals AS sf
    ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  GROUP BY tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist
),
order_type_averages AS (
  SELECT
    ordertypedist,
    AVG(avg_short_interest_days_to_cover) AS order_type_avg_short_interest
  FROM transaction_sentiment
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT
  ts.transreg AS transaction_reference,
  ts.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix,
  ts.avg_short_interest_days_to_cover,
  ts.avg_option_volume_ratio,
  ts.avg_short_interest_days_to_cover / ota.order_type_avg_short_interest AS ratio_to_order_type_average
FROM transaction_sentiment AS ts
LEFT JOIN order_type_averages AS ota
  ON ota.ordertypedist = ts.ordertypedist
ORDER BY ratio_to_order_type_average IS NULL, ratio_to_order_type_average DESC
LIMIT 10;
